action.new_text:
def filter_api_calls(
    logp_with_result: np.ndarray,
    logp_call_only: np.ndarray,
    logp_no_call: np.ndarray,
    tau_filter: float,
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""
    # Validate inputs
    for name, arr in [("logp_with_result", logp_with_result),
                      ("logp_call_only", logp_call_only),
                      ("logp_no_call", logp_no_call)]:
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a numpy array")
        if arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be 2-dimensional")
        if arr.shape[0] == 0:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must have at least one candidate")
        if not np.all(np.isfinite(arr)):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains non-finite values")
        if np.any(arr > 0):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains positive values (must be nonpositive)")
    # Check same shape
    shape = logp_with_result.shape
    if logp_call_only.shape != shape or logp_no_call.shape != shape:
        raise ValueError("Input arrays must have the same shape")
    # Validate tau_filter
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter cannot be a boolean")
    if not isinstance(tau_filter, (int, float)):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a numeric value")
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite")
    if tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be nonnegative")

    n_candidates, horizon = shape

    # Compute normalized future-token weights
    if horizon == 0:
        # No future tokens; special case: margin is 0? According to procedure, no tokens means no loss difference.
        margin = np.zeros(n_candidates)
        keep = margin >= tau_filter
        return keep, margin

    t = np.arange(horizon)  # offset 0..H-1
    raw = np.maximum(0.0, 1.0 - 0.2 * t)
    weights = raw / raw.sum()  # normalized weights

    # Compute weighted future-token losses (negative weighted log probability)
    loss_plus = -np.dot(logp_with_result, weights)   # shape (n_candidates,)
    loss_only = -np.dot(logp_call_only, weights)
    loss_none = -np.dot(logp_no_call, weights)

    # Stronger counterfactual baseline: min of no_call and call_only
    L_minus = np.minimum(loss_none, loss_only)

    # Margin and filter
    margin = L_minus - loss_plus   # positive means call with result reduced loss
    keep = margin >= tau_filter

    return keep, margin.astype(float)
